verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payments and banking infrastructure, since some payments platforms ship self-hostable components, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or open-source deployment of Increase's core. The docs, probes and community items describe only a hosted API, dashboard and sandbox run by Increase on partner banks. The existence of an official CLI and an OpenAPI spec does not amount to self-hosting the product.
